comment: Pre-seeds framework producer + dependents + reverse-index binding for the polyglot order.created propagation. Applied after tree-sitter ingestion, before validate-diff. Producer kind = EventPublisher (shared linking key kafka:order.created). Dependents: 2x EventSubscriber + 1x ContractTest, each tagged with the language whose source file owns it. The reverse-index selector binds the Go PublishOrderCreated function to the EventPublisher so a touched function pulls the producer into the touched set.

selector_bindings.comment: Bind both the Go publisher function and the EventPublisher to one selector so a touched function (Stage 2) pulls the EventPublisher into the touched set via the reverse index (Stage 4 expandTouchedViaReverseIndex). Identical pattern to pipeline_test.go::seedProducerWithTouch.
